title: Controlling the False Discovery Rate via Model-Agnostic Importance Measures
abstract: arXiv:2610.21360v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Selecting covariates while controlling the false discovery rate (FDR) is critical for interpretable scientific discovery, especially with complex machine learning models. Traditional variable selection methods often rely on specific model assumptions, while Model-X knockoffs provide a general way that leverages knowledge of the covariate distribution to produce a variable selection algorithm. This study puts forward a complementary method to Model-X knockoffs, named Model-Agnostic Selection with agent-X importance (MAS), which utilizes the sample-splitting strategy and a novel variable importance measure to bypass distributional assumptions on covariates. translated_title: 通过模型无关的重要性度量控制错误发现率
translated_abstract: 在控制错误发现率（FDR）的同时选择协变量对于可解释的科学发现至关重要，尤其是在使用复杂机器学习模型的场景下。传统的变量选择方法通常依赖于特定的模型假设，而Model-X knockoffs则提供了一种通用方法，利用协变量分布的知识来构建变量选择算法。本研究提出了一种与Model-X knockoffs互补的方法，称为基于agent-X重要性的模型无关选择（MAS），该方法利用样本分割策略和新颖的变量重要性度量，从而绕过对协变量分布的假设。所提出的模型无关agent-X重要性被定义为在总体水平上评估原始分布与加入agent变量后的分布之间oracle预测能力的差异，并且可以通过将agent变量构造为某种形式的变量来高效估计（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了MAS方法，通过样本分割策略和新颖的agent-X变量重要性度量，在无需对协变量做分布假设的情况下实现错误发现率（FDR）控制下的模型无关变量选择，与Model-X knockoffs形成互补。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MAS (Model-Agnostic Selection with agent-X importance), which leverages sample splitting and a novel variable importance measure to achieve FDR-controlled variable selection without distributional assumptions on covariates, complementing Model-X knockoffs.
